steps.tx: **Bacterial vaginosis** (**pH over 4.5**, **clue cells**, **whiff fishy KOH**, thin grey homogenous; **Gardnerella** anaerobes, douching risks; **metronidazole** 400 7 days or 2 g single, **clindamycin**, **pregnancy** treats preterm) with **trichomoniasis** (**frothy yellow green**, **strawberry cervix**, motile flagellates, **partner treats**, **metronidazole 2 g single** both) cures; **recurrence** (biofilm, re-exposure) retreats. Wet mount whiffs.
